Who gets alerted when stock runs low or finishes

Set by the team list (role "Manager").
Off
Pop-up alerts on the restaurant PC/tablet while this page is open.
Manager installs the ntfy app and subscribes to this same topic name. Use a long, hard-to-guess name — anyone who knows it can read the alerts.
Not set

⛔ Finished — item reaches zero (out of stock). Highest priority.

🥜 Allergens

⚠️ Only a few obvious allergens are filled in to start. Check every item against your supplier's product sheets, tick its allergens, then tick Confirmed. Until then customers see "Not confirmed yet — please ask our staff".

📱 Table QR codes

Customers scan the code on their table and order from their phone. The ticket shows the table number.

ℹ️ Orders from customers' phones reach the kitchen only when the dashboard has an online database (the next step). Until then, use the codes on the restaurant's own tablets, or for testing.
